# setup-planning

Run the planning-setup skill. Configure GitHub, GitLab, or local markdown tickets and record glossary/ADR paths so later ticket and handoff skills share one layout.

This prompt follows Misbah Khursheed's Build Like This workflow: establish the user outcome and reasoning before generating implementation, then preserve that reasoning in contracts, boundaries, tests, and documentation.

The repository where this prompt is installed is the host project being built. ## Method

1. Inspect remotes, docs/, and existing agent instruction files.
2. Ask tracker choice, then labels, then non-default doc paths—one section at a time with a recommended default.
3. Write docs/agents/issue-tracker.md with the agreed adapter notes.
4. Add a short pointer in the existing AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
5. Stop after setup without creating tickets or specs.

- Pointer in existing agent instructions.
